source_lines_after.55: [F1] *Root coordinates of $\mathrm{SL}_2$.* $X(T_2)=\mathbb Z\chi$, $\Phi=\{\pm2\chi\}$, $\alpha=2\chi$, $\alpha^\vee=\chi^\vee$ with $\langle\chi,\alpha^\vee\rangle=1$, the Weyl group is $\{1,s_\alpha\}$ acting by $s_\alpha(\chi)=\chi-\langle\chi,\alpha^\vee\rangle\alpha=-\chi$, $u_\alpha(a)=\binom{1\ a}{0\ 1}$, $u_{-\alpha}(a)=\binom{1\ 0}{a\ 1}$, and $\mathrm{SL}_2$ is generated by $U^+$ and $U^-$ ([[lem-sl2-structure-and-root-coordinates|Structure of $\mathrm{SL}_2$ and root coordinates]], [[def-root-datum-of-a-split-reductive-group]]).
